title: delphinium peregrinum var. obcordatum
intro: Delphinium peregrinum var. obcordatum, commonly known as the 'Narrow-leaved Larkspur', is a flowering plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, such as fever and cough, due to its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Delphinium peregrinum var. obcordatum include expectorant, antispasmodic, and antitussive effects, making it a potential treatment for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as delphinine and ajacine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
